composition: Walled medieval hilltown crowning Isola del Giglio · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the sea side, the tourist faces Giglio Castello crowning its rocky peak, the medieval walls and round towers wrapping the hillside center-frame above the clustered stone houses. Bare granite crags rise behind the rooftops, while the open sea fills the left under a bright, partly cloudy sky. The 08:44 sun lights the old walls and terracotta roofs, with green scrub clinging to the rocks below.
